holder-quote: The [Grand Strategist] pointed. The [General] and his [Soldiers] fell back as Grimalkin leapt forwards. The Flamewardens breathed as one and retreated. The flames licked around the Greater Wyvern and he hissed, but it did nothing to him. Relc bounded away as Grimalkin leapt in.
effect-quote: Grimalkin felt an impact slam him backwards. Pectoral muscles tore.

holder-quote: But Ozem hadn’t used it on Flos Reimarch, or Mars, or Orthenon.
effect-quote: turned his command into a force that could have fought shoulder-to-shoulder with the King of Destruction and all his elites for a time

holder-quote: Grimalkin slowly maneuvered his bent arm a fraction.
